newsitem.title: USA: Dow cracks 7000 level, NYSE curbs set.
newsitem.headline: Dow cracks 7000 level, NYSE curbs set.

text.p: The Dow industrials added to morning gains on Wednesday, trading above the 7000 level for the first time since March 13.
The Dow was up 60 points at 7022, a rise of 0.9 percent. The gains triggered the New York Stock Exchange's curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 1128 EDT/1528 GMT.
"It's being helped by the recovery in bonds," said Gregory Nie, technical analyst at EVEREN Securities.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 9/32, its yield dropping to 6.96 percent. Bonds and stocks fell in early trade in reaction to stronger-than-expected GDP data.
